bundle.shortDescription: A desktop laboratory for prototyping Spindle authoring techniques.
bundle.longDescription: Spindle Lab is a desktop laboratory app built with Tauri, Rust, and React for prototyping and de-risking techniques before they land in Spindle, Liminal HQ's DVD/Blu-ray authoring studio.
